description.en: Plugins by ZHIRAI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 智睿科技为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的插件。

description.en: Token cost monitoring, model-call efficiency analysis and reversible tool-output caching for DeepSeek Harness. Per-call four-bucket ledger cross-checked against official usage, 11 efficiency findings, 5 task types with historical baseline, reversible cache with token_manager_read restore, context dry-run analysis, tasks/projects with summaries and exports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 成本监控、模型调用效率分析与可逆工具输出缓存。逐调用四桶台账并与官方用量交叉核对，11 类效率发现，5 类任务与历史基线，可逆缓存与 token_manager_read 原文恢复，上下文 dry-run 分析，任务/项目摘要与导出。
